title: PMBOK Risk Register
description: Schema for a PMBOK 7 risk register entry generated by the Agentic PMBOK Toolkit

risk_id.description: Unique risk identifier in the format RSK-001

title.description: Short, specific risk title. Should name the component and the failure mode.

impact_score.description: Impact severity if the risk materialises (1=negligible, 10=project-ending)

risk_score.description: Computed risk score (optional). Typically probability_weight × impact_score.

mitigation.description: Concrete, actionable mitigation strategy. Avoid vague statements like 'monitor closely'.

contingency.description: Contingency plan if the risk materialises and mitigation fails (optional)

owner.description: Team member or role responsible for monitoring this risk

raised_from.description: Source artifact (e.g. commit SHA, PR number, issue ID) that triggered this risk

date.description: Date the risk was first identified (YYYY-MM-DD)
